tools.name: kipode_info
tools.description: What KIPODE (KI Politik Deutschland, kipode.de) is: fact-based overview of Germany in 2026 (AI and robotics, economy, labour market, energy, demography, public debt, pensions, migration, industry), every figure with its source. Publisher, principle, key links.

tools.name: themen
tools.description: Lists kipode.de pages with title, description, last update, URL and Markdown URL. Optional: query (filters title/description/URL, German words work best, e.g. "Rente", "Insolvenzen", "Roboter"), type (themenseite|ki-radar|beruf|sprachfassung), limit (default 30).

tools.name: aktuelles
tools.description: Newest updates on kipode.de (KI-Radar and topic page updates), newest first, with date, category, summary and link. Optional: limit (default 10, max 30).

tools.name: suche
tools.description: Searches all sections of kipode.de for a word or phrase (German) and returns matching pages and section anchors. Required: query.

tools.name: seite_als_markdown
tools.description: Returns a kipode.de page as clean Markdown (text, tables, sources, without menu). Required: url or path, e.g. "https://kipode.de/rente-deutschland.html" or "/insolvenzen/". Long pages are cut after max_chars (default 60000).

tools.name: kontakt
tools.description: Contact e-mail, address for corrections, imprint. Does not send anything.
